strongest_angle: Examine the nearly eight-year legal battle between AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents over major rock festivals, detailing the failed $18.9 million buy-sell proposal and the upcoming February 2027 jury trial in Los Angeles Superior Court.

key_facts.fact: AEG Presents offered roughly 18.9 million dollars to either buy out Danny Wimmer Presents' half of Rock on the Range and Carolina Rebellion or sell its own half to DWP.
The legal battle between AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents over two major rock festivals is moving toward a scheduled February 2027 jury trial in Los Angeles Superior Court.
AEG Live Productions sued Danny Wimmer Presents after their relationship broke down and DWP began promoting its own Sonic Temple Art + Music Festival.
